result.summary: The image shows a one-way urban street with a bus stop and a signalized intersection. While sidewalks and a marked crosswalk are present, the markings are heavily faded and the wide roadway creates a significant crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.description: The stopped bus at the transit stop blocks sightlines between pedestrians and vehicles in adjacent lanes.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a basic sidewalk and a signalized crossing with significantly faded zebra markings. While essential infrastructure like curb ramps and traffic lights are present, the lack of dedicated pedestrian signals and the degraded state of the pavement markings increase risk in this commercial setting.

hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are heavily worn and faded, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian walk/don't-walk signals are visible at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals.

interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk using high-visibility continental or ladder patterns to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to clarify right-of-way and remaining crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and traffic signals, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the environment lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and physical separation like refuge islands, leaving pedestrians exposed across multiple lanes of traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: While vehicle traffic lights are present, there are no visible dedicated pedestrian signal heads to indicate safe crossing times.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway without a median or refuge island for protection.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and wear on the road surface near the crosswalk could present tripping hazards or affect vehicle braking.
